summary: Goldman Sachs Real Estate Finance Trust Inc filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 358,697 Class I shares for $8.95M and 35,112 Class S shares for $0.88M under its ongoing Reg D private offering, plus monthly distributions of $0.1480–$0.2140 per share across classes payable November 10, 2026 to holders of record October 31, 2026, and a $77.9M floating-rate first mortgage origination on a Richmond, Virginia industrial asset at SOFR plus 2.50%. These are routine capital-raising and portfolio events, not a special situation; watch continued NAV-based share sales and distribution coverage.
